name: gen-ai-skills
description: A collection of generative AI skills that can be run as standalone servers or integrated into larger applications.

skill.description: The name of the skill to run (e.g., text_to_image, image_to_image, controlnet, text_to_video).

HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN.description: Hugging Face Hub token required to download the models. Can be set as an environment variable.

port.description: The port to run the server on.

host.description: The host to run the server on.

tools.name: text_to_image
tools.description: Generates an image from a text prompt.

prompt.description: The text prompt to generate an image from.

tools.name: image_to_image
tools.description: Generates an image from a text prompt and an input image.

prompt.description: The text prompt to guide the image generation.

tools.name: controlnet
tools.description: Generates an image from a text prompt, an input image, and a condition.

prompt.description: The text prompt to guide the image generation.

tools.name: text_to_video
tools.description: Generates a video from a text prompt.

prompt.description: The text prompt to generate a video from.

docker.description: Run the server in a Docker container. Build the image first with 'docker build -t picsart/gen-ai-skills .' or pull from a registry if available. Replace <skill_name> with the desired skill and <your_token> with your Hugging Face token.

python.description: Run the server using Python after installing with 'pip install gen-ai-skills'. Replace <skill_name> with the desired skill. Ensure HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN is set as an environment variable.

examples.title: Generate an image from text
examples.description: This example uses the text_to_image skill to generate a picture of an astronaut on Mars via a cURL request to the /invoke endpoint.
examples.prompt: curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt": "a photo of an astronaut riding a horse on mars"}' http://localhost:8080/invoke
